task_title: Wire remember --wait: flush + await namespace commit
task_criteria: Driving the real CLI (node bin/duckbrain.js remember <key> --domain=raw_note --content=... --namespace=<scratch-ns> --wait) with DUCKBRAIN_NAMESPACES_PATH/CONFIG_PATH redirected to a scratch root: (1) WITH --wait the command exits 0, stdout reports the commit landed, and stdout does NOT contain the buffered phrasing 'will be committed in batch'; (2) WITH --wait, after exit the scratch namespace has a .git dir, git log has at least one commit, git status --porcelain is EMPTY, and the remembered key is grep-findable in the namespace JSONL files; (3) WITHOUT --wait the legacy buffered message 'will be committed in batch' still prints and the end state is identical (exit-flush commit present); (4) RED control: reverting ONLY src/cli/human.ts to HEAD (git show HEAD:src/cli/human.ts > src/cli/human.ts) makes criterion (1) fail — the old buffered phrasing reappears — then restoring the fixed file makes it pass again; (5) npx tsc --noEmit clean and the full unit suite green with the new suite counted in AGENTS.md (both count lines synced).
